verses.text: David gather all di princes of Israel, di princes of di tribes, di captains of di groups wey serve di king, di captains of thousands, di captains of hundreds, di rulers over all di property and possessions of di king and of im pikin dem, with di officers, di mighty men and all di brave and mighty men, come Jerusalem.

Den King David stand up on im feet and talk say, “Hear me, my brothers and my people. As for me, e dey my heart to build house of rest for di ark of di covenant of di Lord, for di footstool of our God, and I don prepare for di building.
But God talk to me say, ‘You no go build house for my name, because you be man of war and you don shed blood.’

Still, di Lord, di God of Israel, choose me from all my papa house to be king over Israel forever, because e don choose Judah to be ruler. For Judah house, my papa house, and among my papa pikin dem, e take pleasure for me to make me king over all Israel.
From all my pikin dem, because di Lord don give me plenty pikin, e don choose Solomon my pikin to sit for di throne of di kingdom of di Lord over Israel.
E talk to me say, ‘Solomon your pikin, na im go build my house and my courts, because I don choose am to be my pikin, and I go be im papa.
I go make im kingdom stand forever, if e continue to do my commands and my rules, as e dey do today.’

So now, for di eyes of all Israel, di gathering of di Lord, and for di ears of our God, take care and look for all di commands of di Lord your God, so that una go possess dis good land and leave am as inheritance to una pikin dem after una forever.

You, Solomon my pikin, know di God of your papa and serve am with perfect heart and with willing mind, because di Lord dey search all hearts and understand all di thoughts of di mind. If you look for am, you go find am, but if you leave am, e go throw you away forever.
Take care now, because di Lord don choose you to build house for di sanctuary. Be strong and do am.”
Den David give im pikin Solomon di plan of di porch of di temple, and of im houses, and of im treasuries, and of im upper rooms, and of im inner rooms, and of di place of di mercy seat,
and di plan of all wey e get by di Spirit for di courts of di Lord house, and for all di rooms round, for di treasuries of God house and for di treasuries of di things wey dem give to God,
and for di groups of di priests and di Levites, and for all di work of di service of di Lord house, and for all di vessels of service for di Lord house,
di gold by weight for di gold vessels for every kind of service, and di silver by weight for all di silver vessels for every kind of service,

di weight for di gold lampstands and for dem gold lamps, by weight for every lampstand and for im lamps, and for di silver lampstands, by weight for every lampstand and for im lamps, according to di use of every lampstand,
and di gold by weight for di tables of di bread of di presence, for every table, and silver for di silver tables,
and di forks, di basins and di pitchers of pure gold, and for di gold bowls by weight for every bowl, and for di silver bowls by weight for every bowl,
and for di altar of incense refined gold by weight, and gold for di plan of di chariot of di cherubim wey spread dem wings and cover di ark of di covenant of di Lord.
David talk say, “Di Lord make me understand all dis in writing by im hand on me, even all di works of dis plan.”

David talk to Solomon im pikin say, “Be strong and brave, and do am. No fear and no shake, because di Lord God, even my God, dey with you. E no go fail you or leave you until all di work for di service of di Lord house finish.

Look, di groups of di priests and di Levites dey for all di service of God house, and every willing skilled man go dey with you for all di work, for any kind of service. Di captains and all di people go also dey fully under your command.”
King David talk to all di gathering say, “Solomon my pikin, di only one wey God don choose, still dey young and soft, and di work big, because di palace no be for man, but for di Lord God.

Now I don prepare with all my strength for di house of my God di gold for di things of gold, di silver for di things of silver, di bronze for di things of bronze, di iron for di things of iron, and wood for di things of wood, onyx stones, stones to set, stones for inlay, stones of different colors, all kind of precious stones and plenty marble stones.
Again, because I don set my love on di house of my God, as I get my own treasure of gold and silver, I give am to di house of my God, apart from all wey I don prepare for di holy house:
3,000 talents of gold, from di gold of Ophir, and 7,000 talents of refined silver, to cover di walls of di houses,
gold for di things of gold, and silver for di things of silver, and for all kind of work wey di craftsmen hands go make. Who go give willingly today to give imself to di Lord?”
Den di princes of di papa dem houses, di princes of di tribes of Israel, di captains of thousands and of hundreds, with di rulers over di king work, give willingly,
and give for di service of God house gold, 5,000 talents and 10,000 gold coins, silver 10,000 talents, bronze 18,000 talents and iron 100,000 talents.
Dem wey get precious stones give dem to di treasure of di Lord house, under di hand of Jehiel di Gershonite.
Den di people rejoice because dem give willingly, because dem give to di Lord willingly with perfect heart. King David rejoice with big joy too.
So David bless di Lord before all di gathering. David talk say, “Make dem bless you, di Lord, di God of Israel our papa, forever and ever.

Yours, di Lord, na di greatness, di power, di glory, di victory and di majesty, because all wey dey heaven and for earth na your own. Yours na di kingdom, di Lord, and you dey lifted up as head over all.
Both riches and honor dey come from you, and you dey rule over all. Power and might dey your hand, and for your hand e dey to make great and to give strength to all.
Now, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.
But who be me, and who be my people, say we fit give willingly like dis? Because all things come from you, and na from wetin be your own we don give you.
Because we be strangers and foreigners before you, as all our papa dem be. Our days for di earth dey like shadow, and no place dey to stay.
Di Lord our God, all dis wealth wey we don prepare to build house for you for your holy name come from your hand, and all na your own.

I know too, my God, say you dey test di heart and you dey take pleasure for honesty. As for me, for di honesty of my heart I don give all dis things willingly, and now I don see with joy your people wey dey here dey give to you willingly.
Di Lord, di God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, our papa dem, keep dis forever for di thoughts of di heart of your people, and prepare dem heart for you,
and give Solomon my pikin perfect heart to keep your commands, your warnings and your laws, and to do all dis things, and to build di palace, wey I don make provision for.”
David talk to all di gathering say, “Now bless di Lord your God.” All di gathering bless di Lord, di God of dem papa dem, bow down dem heads and lie face down before di Lord and before di king.

Dem make sacrifice to di Lord and offer burnt sacrifice to di Lord for di next day after dat day, 1,000 bulls, 1,000 rams and 1,000 lambs, with dem drink offerings and plenty sacrifices for all Israel,
and dem eat and drink before di Lord dat day with big gladness. Dem make Solomon, David pikin, king di second time, and anoint am before di Lord to be ruler, and Zadok to be priest.
Den Solomon sit for di throne of di Lord as king for im papa David place, and e prosper. All Israel obey am.
All di princes, di mighty men and all King David pikin dem bow to Solomon di king.
Di Lord make Solomon big well well for di eyes of all Israel and give am royal majesty wey no king for Israel get before am.
So David, Jesse pikin, rule over all Israel.
Di time wey e rule over Israel na 40 years. E rule seven years for Hebron, and e rule 33 years for Jerusalem.
E die for good old age, full of days, riches and honor, and im pikin Solomon rule for im place.
Now di acts of King David, from first to last, look, dem write dem for di history of Samuel di seer, for di history of Nathan di prophet and for di history of Gad di seer,
with all im rule and im power, and di times wey pass over am, and over Israel, and over all di kingdoms of di countries.
